A LITTLE MORE ABOUT ME ↗

Organized mind.
Open heart.

I'm a Psychology graduate and Certified Human Resource Associate, with a soft spot for making complex days feel a little easier.

From managing ticket orders and customer communication to HR support, administrative work, and creative freelance projects, I've learned that thoughtful work is a mix of precision and empathy.

I enjoy creating order out of the everyday, communicating clearly, and bringing a warm, dependable energy to every team.
